event.distribution_pattern: Products distributed to Utah and California. No foreign, military/govt/VA consignees.

products.product_description: Western Nut Salt Lake City Roasted and Salted Inshell Peanuts, 6 oz (170g). Packaged in OPP (oriented polypropylene) bags. Receive bulk roasted/salted inshell peanuts from US Foods in 25 lb lined cases. Manufactured by Hampton Farms, Portales, NM for Western Nut.
products.reason_for_recall: Western Nut is recalling certain lots of Roasted/Salted Inshell Peanuts due to unacceptable levels of Aflatoxin.
